definitions.explanation: Refers to a single location where people gather together. Almost always used in the phrase 一堂に会する (to assemble in one place), indicating that a group gathers at the same location.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一堂|いちどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{会|かい}した。
examples.english: The people involved all gathered in one place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一堂|いちどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A conference was held where researchers from around the world gathered in one place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一堂|いちどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧きた。
examples.english: I went to an event where dishes by famous chefs were all displayed together.

notes:
USAGE: {一堂|いちどう} almost always appears in the fixed phrase {一堂|いちどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{会|かい}する (to gather in one place) or {一堂|いちどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧. It is a formal expression used in news, announcements, and written descriptions of gatherings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一堂|いちどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{会|かい}する (to assemble in one place)
- {一堂|いちどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧ (to gather together)
- {一堂|いちどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ (to be lined up together)
- {一堂|いちどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{介|かい}する→介する：11664_kaisuru⟧ (variant of {会|かい}する)

NOTE: Do not confuse with ⟦{一同|いちどう}→一同：08918_ichidou⟧ (everyone present, all members), which refers to the people themselves rather than the place of gathering.
